changeSet.author: garcol
changeSet.comment: Per-symbol price configuration: the delta threshold driving the stream.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE price_configs ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, symbol_pair character varying(32) NOT NULL, delta_percent numeric(9, 6) NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT pk_price_configs PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_price_configs_symbol_pair UNIQUE (symbol_pair) )
